title: Timeline Agent Output
description: Schema for the timeline/sync agent output. Each day contains a timeline object where keys are activity names and values contain start/end times and optional duration.

timeline_activity.description: A single timeline activity entry with start/end times.

start_time.description: Activity start time in HH:MM format.

end_time.description: Activity end time in HH:MM format.

duration_minutes.description: Duration in minutes (optional, can be computed from start/end).

transit.description: True if this entry is a transit/travel segment (walk to, taxi to, etc.), not a POI. Used by sync and HTML generator to skip non-POI entries.

meal_ref.description: Links this timeline entry to a meal. Set by migration/timeline agent.

accommodation_ref.description: True if this entry references the day's accommodation (e.g. hotel check-in).

transport_ref.description: True if this entry references a transportation segment (e.g. arrival via metro/airport express).

optional.description: True if this activity is part of an alternative plan branch (Plan B/C).

plan_label.description: Plan branch label for alternative activities (e.g. 'B', 'C').

travel_segment.description: An intra-city transit segment between two activities.

name_base.description: English transit description, e.g. 'Taxi to Raffles City Hotel'

name_local.description: Local language transit description, e.g. '打车前往来福士酒店'

type_local.description: Transport type in local language (e.g., '步行', '出租车', '地铁')

day_entry.description: Per-day timeline container. RC-4 (2026-05-04): additionalProperties tightened from true to false with explicit allowlist to prevent silent typo'd or unexpected keys leaking into production data.

location.description: Primary city/region for the day in base language (e.g., 'Beijing').

location_local.description: Primary city/region in local language (e.g., '北京').

timeline.description: Map of activity name to timeline entry. Keys are human-readable activity names.

travel_segments.description: Intra-city transit segments between activities. Generated by timeline agent using transportation.json route data.

warnings.description: Optional human-readable warnings emitted by the timeline agent.

split_day.description: True iff this day has parallel sub-itineraries (shared/matilde/jade). When true, the per-traveler keys carry timeline entries in addition to (or instead of) the base `timeline` object.

shared.description: Split-day shared timeline: activities both travelers do together. Same shape as `timeline`.

matilde.description: Split-day Matilde-only timeline. Same shape as `timeline`.

jade.description: Split-day Jade-only timeline. Same shape as `timeline`.
